exposure: super obese women undergoing emergency CD
super obese women undergoing nonemergency CD
maternal BMI (BMI 18.5 to 29.9 kg/m2, BMI 30 to 39.9 kg/m2, BMI 40 to 49.9 kg/m2, and BMI >= 50 kg/m2)
maternal body mass index (BMI) at delivery
outcome: intraoperative injury (bowel, bladder, ureteral injury; broad ligament hematoma)
cohort: This study included 51,218 women with singleton pregnancies from the deidentified Maternal-Fetal Medicine Unit Cesarean Registry.
finding: Contrary to expectations, the risk of intraoperative complications during cesarean delivery does not seem to be increased in obese women, even among those with super obesity.
